name: NSE Swing Master Auto Alerts

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      report_mode:
        description: 'Choose report type to test'
        required: true
        default: 'daily'
        type: choice
        options:
          - daily
          - weekly
          - monthly
  schedule:
    # 09:40 UTC = 3:10 PM IST (Mon-Fri) -> Pre-Close Live Capture Preview
    - cron: '40 9 * * 1-5'
    # 10:25 UTC = 3:55 PM IST (Mon-Fri) -> Final NSE Close & 4:00 PM Tomorrow's Buy Alert
    - cron: '25 10 * * 1-5'
    # 04:30 UTC = 10:00 AM IST (Saturday) -> Weekly Bot Performance & MTF Report
    - cron: '30 4 * * 6'
    # 05:00 UTC = 10:30 AM IST (1st of Month) -> Monthly Bot Performance & MTF Report
    - cron: '0 5 1 * *'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  run-swing-scanner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Determine Report Mode
        id: set_mode
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "mode=${{ github.event.inputs.report_mode }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ "${{ github.event.schedule }}" = "30 4 * * 6" ]; then
            echo "mode=weekly" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ "${{ github.event.schedule }}" = "0 5 1 * *" ]; then
            echo "mode=monthly" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "mode=daily" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run Swing Scanner & Send Telegram Alert
        env:
          TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID }}
        run: python swing_master_330pm.py --now --mode "${{ steps.set_mode.outputs.mode }}"

      - name: Commit Signal History for Weekly/Monthly Tracking
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f history/bot_signals_log.csv ]; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add history/bot_signals_log.csv
            if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
              git commit -m "Log swing bot signals [skip ci]"
              git pull --rebase || true
              git push
            fi
          fi

      - name: Save CSV & HTML Watchlist / Reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: swing-reports-${{ steps.set_mode.outputs.mode }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            *.csv
            *.html
          retention-days: 30
